SNOP - Snowboarding Slop

Think you can snowboard? Prove it.

SNOP is a brutally unforgiving physics-based snowboarding challenge inspired by games like QWOP, where every movement matters and every mistake can send you crashing down the mountain.

You don't control a snowboarder — you control the struggle. Each joystick controls a different heel:

  • Left joystick = left heel

  • Right joystick = right heel

Your goal is simple: make it down the course. Actually doing it is the hard part.

Expect awkward movements, ridiculous crashes, and mechanics designed to test your patience. SNOP isn't about smooth tricks or effortless runs — it's about mastering an intentionally difficult control system and overcoming the chaos.

Can you conquer the mountain?

A $200 prize is available for the first person to complete the challenge. Full rules, requirements, and details are available on the DeckTronic web page.

Good luck. You'll need it.
